manual_review_reason: The first-party form accepts an MP3 or WAV upload and/or music link and states that Owl Radio accepts submissions from anyone with recordings, but the route is multi-step. Later-step required fields, possible CAPTCHA or identity controls, upload-size and audio-quality limits, track-count rules, explicit-content policy, rights or broadcast declarations, release-window requirements and AI-origin policy are not fully published. A human must choose one suitable MarcsMusic track, inspect the exact master, link and metadata, verify every later step and declaration, avoid duplicate outreach through general or staff contacts, and submit manually.
